const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import collections
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
baseline = '8e2fae4e3a3a3fb84651dcbfb6591de20ec45501'
translation_files = ['mod-tome.lua', 'tome-cults.lua', 'tome-orcs.lua']
term_files = [
    'terminology/creatures.tsv',
    'terminology/items.tsv',
    'terminology/narrative.tsv',
    'terminology/society.tsv',
    'terminology/talents.tsv',
]
workset = json.loads((root / '.ai/task/repair-w59-20261001/WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
term_edits = json.loads((root / '.ai/task/repair-w59-20261001/TERM-EDITS.json').read_text())
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest(root)))

def git_bytes(path):
    return subprocess.run(
        ['git', 'show', f'{baseline}:{path}'], cwd=root, check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
    ).stdout

def stripped(record):
    return {k: v for k, v in record.items() if k not in {'line', 'target', 'logical_path'}}

changed = []
counts = {}
records = {}
for file in translation_files:
    old_doc = loader.load_bytes(git_bytes(file), logical_path=file)
    new_doc = loader.load_path(root / file, logical_path=file)
    assert len(old_doc.records) == len(new_doc.records), (file, len(old_doc.records), len(new_doc.records))
    file_changed = 0
    for old, new in zip(old_doc.records, new_doc.records):
        assert stripped(old) == stripped(new), (file, old.get('line'), old, new)
        if old.get('target') != new.get('target'):
            assert old.get('kind') == new.get('kind') == 'translation'
            changed.append((file, old, new))
            file_changed += 1
    counts[file] = file_changed
    records[file] = len(new_doc.translations)
assert counts == {'mod-tome.lua': 33, 'tome-cults.lua': 1, 'tome-orcs.lua': 10}, counts
assert len(changed) == 44

def frozen_key(file, record, target_field):
    return (
        file,
        record['section'],
        record['source'],
        record.get(target_field),
        record.get('source_tag'),
        json.dumps(record.get('args_order'), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
        json.dumps(record.get('special'), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
    )
expected = collections.Counter(
    (
        item['normalized_path'], item['section'], item['source'], item['target_preimage'],
        item.get('source_tag'),
        json.dumps(item.get('args_order'), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
        json.dumps(item.get('special'), ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
    )
    for item in workset
)
actual = collections.Counter(frozen_key(file, old, 'target') for file, old, new in changed)
assert actual == expected, (actual - expected, expected - actual)

term_counts = {}
expected_by_file = collections.defaultdict(list)
for edit in term_edits:
    expected_by_file[edit['file']].append((edit['old'], edit['new']))
for file in term_files:
    old_lines = git_bytes(file).decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True)
    new_lines = (root / file).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True)
    assert len(old_lines) == len(new_lines)
    diffs = [(old.rstrip('\n'), new.rstrip('\n')) for old, new in zip(old_lines, new_lines) if old != new]
    assert collections.Counter(diffs) == collections.Counter(expected_by_file[file]), (file, diffs, expected_by_file[file])
    assert old_lines[-1].endswith('\n') == new_lines[-1].endswith('\n')
    term_counts[file] = len(diffs)
assert term_counts == {
    'terminology/creatures.tsv': 3,
    'terminology/items.tsv': 2,
    'terminology/narrative.tsv': 2,
    'terminology/society.tsv': 3,
    'terminology/talents.tsv': 11,
}, term_counts
assert sum(term_counts.values()) == 21

wanted = {
    '34475db9b1986168e05f451ac28eedc01384085c5af842806e8cf246669675c8': '最近她的丈夫去世了，悲痛让她发了疯。',
    '7abfa1439401cff8b10346e735d6939c3ad46d642257e3413391791775fd43a5': '永远在燃烧，永远在死去，永远在重生，凤凰向你俯冲而来，想让你分享它炽烈的命运。',
    '86192a30aa44a613d9eb0679c529a673a0146701dd3e5fedc1b8fc97b4edc75d': '若风暴之怒已激活，这一法术有 25%% 的几率尝试触发它。',
}
for revision, fragment in wanted.items():
    item = next(item for item in workset if item['entry_revision_identity'] == revision)
    matches = [new for file, old, new in changed if file == item['normalized_path'] and old['source'] == item['source'] and old['section'] == item['section'] and old.get('source_tag') == item.get('source_tag')]
    assert len(matches) == 1 and fragment in matches[0]['target'], (revision, matches)

print('PASS translation baseline/current comparison')
print('changed targets:', len(changed), counts)
print('LuaJIT loaded translations:', records)
print('PASS terminology baseline/current comparison')
print('changed terminology lines:', sum(term_counts.values()), term_counts)
print('PASS all 5 repair texts match frozen adjudication/TERM-EDITS new')
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":16000});
